text:
anna: Quick sync — proposing a canonical quantized-bench protocol for FP8/INT8/4-bit runs.

mike: +1. We need to standardize warmup and power settings, otherwise numbers jump around.

serena: Agreed. Suggested baseline:
- power limit pinned to 250W (or device-specific equivalent)
- run two phases: cold (no KV priming) and hot (KV primed + cache warmed)
- 5 runs each, median tokens/s, report stddev

raj: Also capture kernel selection logs (cupti/nsys) and batching histogram.
We should store which kernels were picked per layer for reproducibility.

anna: Perf checklist I'm thinking of:
1) set GPU PL
2) disable boost clocks variability (nvidia-smi -ac locked)
3) pre-tokenize input set and seed RNGs
4) run calibration-only pass (for int8/4-bit) and save scales
5) measure latency and throughput with KV cache cold vs hot

mike: For calibration: run on the same token distribution as eval. Calibration batch size and sequence length must match production mix. Otherwise quant noise skew.

serena: Note on tokenization: different tokenizers (BPE vs sentencepiece) change token counts. Always report tokens-per-second and tokens-per-input to be fair.
Include a small snippet for our harness:

```
# harness pseudo
export GPU_POWER_LIMIT=250
python bench.py --model f16 -> --quant int8 --calibrate scales.pt \
  --warmup-seqs 100 --measure-runs 5 --batcher-config batcher.json
```

raj: KV cache behavior: measure hit-rate when prefixing repeated prompts. We should report per-step token throughput and KV memory footprint after warmup.

perf-bot: auto-note: attach nsys timeline and kernel table to the run metadata (mandatory)

anna: Regression policy: if quantized run deviates >2% perplexity (or NLL) from fp16 on the eval set, fail the quant rollout regardless of perf.

mike: We also need microprofile outputs: layer-wise op time for attention, matmul, softmax so kernel selection changes are visible.

serena: On mixed precision (FP8): some kernels are faster but calibration sensitive. Add a "calibration delta" column: accuracy before/after calibration.

raj: Action items:
- anna: draft protocol doc and add a benchmark script
- mike: add nsys capture to bench harness
- serena: prepare a small 1k-token calibration set matching product traffic
- raj: add KV priming utility to the bench

anna: I'll open a PR with the protocol draft later today. If anyone has objections to the power cap or pass counts shout now.

mike: fine with 250W for 80GB A100 baseline. For smaller GPUs we should normalize to TDP%.

serena: 👍
